en: A black-and-white image showing a street with several old, somewhat dilapidated houses featuring tiled roofs. There are bare trees along the sidewalk, a few cars (likely from the 1960s or 1970s), and a traffic sign. In the background, there are modern apartment blocks, suggesting a contrast between old and new architecture. The image is somewhat faded, reinforcing a vintage feel. There is a storefront visible with some text above the entrance, though it’s not fully legible.
